name: Stage 15:2: Mellan-Marviken, etapp 15 to Skottvångs gruva
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 15:2, Mellan-Marviken, etapp 15 to Skottvångs gruva.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Mellan-Marviken is a strong overnight/rest node with shared shelters, dry toilet, prepared fireplace/grill, tent space, bathing, and lake water of unknown quality.

Skottvångs gruva is the endpoint service cluster: parking, accessible/toilet context, shower, sauna, tap water, restaurant/cafe/pub, museum, shop/event context, and bookable lodging are nearby, but most services are opening-hour, event, or booking dependent.
No shop, toilet, potable tap, or road access was verified between Mellan-Marviken and Skottvång on the core 15:2 connector.

Direct public transport to Skottvång is weak. Treat Skottvång as the practical car-access endpoint, and use current planners for sparse Skottvångsvägen/Svinsjö gård or book-ahead complementary traffic options; older/current material points to Thursday prebooked service for Skottvångs gruva but it must be verified.
waterSources: No reliable all-hours potable trail water was confirmed on 15:2 itself; carry water or refill at Skottvång/bybastun only when services or booked access are confirmed.

Mellan-Marviken and Millsjön are natural lake water only, and the Mellan-Marviken shelter listing describes water quality as unknown. Treat/filter/boil before use; do not treat lake access as a drinking-water refill.
The Marvikarna spring north of the start belongs to the nearby stage-15 continuation rather than the core connector; it is still natural water and should be treated.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official stage 15:2 is a short alternate/connector from Mellan-Marviken to Skottvångs gruva. Sörmlandsleden lists 4 km; Naturkartan/Äventyrligare and OSM relation-only geometry list about 3.6 km, while longer AllTrails-style traces usually combine stage 15, Fornborgsrundan, Millsjön runt, or Stenhuggarmon options.

OSM relation 3806869 is the correct alternate branch but is stored Skottvång-to-Mellan-Marviken, opposite the official direction, and measures about 3.587 km because it ends at the southern reconnect node 2298697773 instead of continuing to Skottvång. For a standalone official 15:2 route, append the shared Stage 15 tail via ways 220781792, 286933800, and 286933795; this gives about 4.0 km to the Skottvång shelter context.

Route character: follows the Mellan-Marviken area south for just under 1 km, then mixed forest, wetland/boardwalk-prone ground, and Millsjön before rejoining stage 15 shortly before Skottvång. Treat Skottvång shelter/service coordinates as endpoint facilities and keep the southern reconnect separate.

Official 2025-06-02 fault report: fallen trees lie across 15:2 and the Millsjön west-side loop/Fornborgsrundan. The route is passable but awkward, and clearing is limited because the area is biotope-protected.

Official/user comments from 2023 report very wet ground, mosquitoes, and a broken boardwalk directly south of Millsjön; a 2024 hiker report found flooding/washed-out boardwalks and turned back, and 2024/2025/2026 reports still mention fallen trees, mud, overgrowth, or difficult access around Millsjön/Fornborgsrundan.
Do not imply free detouring around Millsjön or the biotope area. Stay on the marked route where possible and avoid damaging protected shore and wetland ground.

Loop naming is easy to mix up in this area. Keep 15:2 as the connector/alternate, and present Fornborgsrundan/Millsjön runt and Stenhuggarmon as separate nested options that reuse parts of Stage 15/15:2 rather than as replacement section geometry.

Långaedet and Marvikarna/Krampan reserve rules apply around the connected route system: do not remove or damage deadwood, fires only where permitted/designated, tenting only at marked places in Krampan for normally max two nights, dogs/pets leashed or caged, and Klövberget/Falkberget bird-protection areas closed February 1-August 15.

Mellan-Marviken shelters are shared by hikers and canoeists and can be busy in season; a 2025 comment reported no firewood during one visit, and older blogs also found no firewood at nearby Marviken fire spots. Skottvång food/lodging/water/toilet access depends on opening hours, events, and booking.

Short distance does not always mean easy conditions: spring flooding, wet boardwalks, long summer grass/nettles, snow-covered markings, and recurring fallen trees can make this a slow half-day when combined with Stenhuggarmon or lunch.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken shelters
facilities.description: Two shared hiker/canoe shelters by Mellan-Marviken with about 12 sleeping spots according to shelter listings. First-come, often popular in season, and firewood is not guaranteed; a 2025 official-page comment reported no firewood during one visit.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken information/map
facilities.description: Mapped information/map board and the OSM relation endpoint/split area; official stage start is slightly closer to the shelter/route nodes by the water.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM-listed Sörmlandsleden dry toilet near the Mellan-Marviken shelter area; verify condition on site and do not confuse it with the separate Långaedet toilet north of the junction.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken fireplace and grill
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at the shelter area. Use only when current fire conditions allow, expect shared pressure, and avoid informal fires.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken tent and bathing area
facilities.description: Tent space and bathing context at the shelter area; follow reserve signs and expect shared use with paddlers.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water only; shelter listings describe the water quality as unknown. Treat/filter and keep washing/toilet needs away from shore.

facilities.name: Mellan-Marviken south picnic/firepit
facilities.description: OSM picnic/firepit south of the main shelter cluster and near the route/lakeshore. Use only if local reserve rules and current fire conditions allow.

facilities.name: Stage 15:2 start and stage-15 junction
facilities.description: Official 15:2 start coordinate at the Mellan-Marviken shelter/Stage 15 area. OSM relation 3806869 attaches to Stage 15 at node 2908209630, with nearby route nodes 2905504798 and 3831461621 closer to the official start.

facilities.name: Stage 15:2 rejoins stage 15
facilities.description: Exact OSM reconnect node 2298697773 where 15:2 rejoins Stage 15 before Skottvång. Standalone 15:2 needs the shared Stage 15 tail via ways 220781792, 286933800, and 286933795 from here.

facilities.name: Nearby stage-15 Marvikarna spring
facilities.description: Nearby natural spring on the stage-15 continuation north of the start, not on core 15:2. Treat/filter and verify seasonal flow.

facilities.name: Fornborgsrundan / ancient fort side route
facilities.description: Approximate side-route context for the ancient-fort/Fornborgsrundan option before Millsjön. This separate 4.5 km loop uses parts of 15:2/15 and should not be merged into the official connector distance.

facilities.name: Millsjön west-side fallen-tree warning
facilities.description: Active official 2025-06-02 warning: fallen trees on 15:2/Fornborgsrundan along Millsjön west side. Passable but awkward; biotope protection limits clearing, so do not clear deadwood or cut new detours.

facilities.name: Millsjön wet ground and boardwalk caution
facilities.description: Official 2023 comments reported very wet ground, mosquitoes, and a broken boardwalk directly south of Millsjön; a 2024 report described flooding/washed-out boardwalks and retreating from the intended branch, and later reviews still mention mud/overgrowth. Carry waterproof footwear and expect slow passage until field-confirmed repaired.

facilities.name: Millsjön natural water and biotope shore
facilities.description: Natural lake/wetland water only, not a potable source. The west-side route area includes protected biotope-sensitive ground; do not cut new detours.

facilities.name: Skottvång shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/fireplace near Skottvång, with nearby service context. First-come and no guaranteed free firewood; Skottvång sources say firewood may be purchasable near the parking shelter.

facilities.name: Second Skottvång wind shelter
facilities.description: Additional mapped lean-to/wind-shelter context; Skottvång sources say two wind shelters sit about 200 m from the mine area with grill context.

facilities.name: Skottvång picnic shelter and fireplace
facilities.description: Picnic shelter/fireplace near the mine area. Firewood may be sold nearby, but do not assume free supply; use only if current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Skottvångs gruva restaurant and services
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe/pub, shop/art/event, and service node at the mine area; published public hours are limited and seasonal/event-dependent, with food not guaranteed weekdays unless confirmed.

facilities.name: Skottvångs Gruvmuseum
facilities.description: Mine museum and industrial-heritage context at Skottvång; opening and access are seasonal/event dependent.

facilities.name: Stokledingsborr heritage marker
facilities.description: Industrial-heritage point near Skottvångs gruva, based on mapped historic-building data.

facilities.name: Skottvång toilets
facilities.description: Toilet and accessible-toilet context at the Skottvång service area; access can depend on opening hours/events.

facilities.name: Skottvång tap water and showers
facilities.description: Tap water, shower, and sauna context via Skottvång bystuga/bybastu services. Treat as service-dependent or booking-dependent rather than guaranteed 24/7.

facilities.name: Skottvång parking and limited overnight parking
facilities.description: Endpoint parking about 40 m from the venue. Caravan/overnight parking may be allowed at the far end but without electricity/toilets/services; check local signs and current Skottvång rules.

facilities.name: Skumbo lodging context
facilities.description: Bookable lodging near Skottvång, about 300 m from the mine area, with beds, stove, bybastu access, grill, simple kitchen, and nearby WC according to Skottvång/ÖSGF sources.

facilities.name: Häxans hus lodging
facilities.description: Bookable small lodging close to Skottvång with three beds and simple amenities; exact coordinate is approximate to the mine/service cluster.

facilities.name: Krampan facility cluster
facilities.description: Nearby reserve cluster with marked tent site, dry toilet, rest areas, fireplaces and parking east of Krampan. This is a nearby reserve facility, not core 15:2 trail infrastructure; use only within designated rules.

facilities.name: Marvikarna/Krampan grill place
facilities.description: Prepared grill/fireplace in the Krampan facility area; fires only at designated places and only when fire conditions allow.

facilities.name: Krampan dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet in the nearby Krampan reserve facility cluster; not directly on core 15:2.

facilities.name: Krampan reserve parking
facilities.description: Nearby reserve parking context for Marvikarna/Krampan, useful for access but not the official 15:2 endpoint parking.

facilities.name: Krampans badplats
facilities.description: Nearby bathing/natural-water context in the reserve. Natural water only; follow reserve and water-safety rules.

facilities.name: Krampan archaeological/heritage site
facilities.description: Nearby archaeological/heritage context in the wider Marvikarna/Krampan reserve, which includes ancient waterway and industrial-history remains.

facilities.name: Svinsjö gård bus context
facilities.description: Closest practical bus context for the Marvikarna/Krampan side; Länsstyrelsen describes weekday morning/afternoon service and about 1 km walking from reserve parking. Live-check line 543.

facilities.name: Skottvång weak bus context
facilities.description: No dependable regular stop was verified at Skottvångs gruva itself. Bus 543/Skottvångsvägen can mean about 3.5 km or 50 minutes of road walking, while complementary traffic is limited, pre-booked, and timetable-dependent.
